title: Operating Lines of Credit Late Charge Percentage After Earlier Late Charges
content:
The percentage applied to the charge base of an Operating Lines of Credit late charge rises with the late charges already charged on the line over the past two years.

## Rule

The percentage is:

| Late charges charged on the line in the twenty-four whole months before today | Percentage of the charge base |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 7% |
| Exactly one | 6% |
| None | The product's late charge percentage |

The count is taken from the line's transaction history: fee charges with the late charge fee code whose dates fall within the twenty-four whole months before today.

## Percentages by product

| Product | None in 24 months | Exactly one | Two or more |
|---|---|---|---|
| StartRight Operating Line | 5% | 6% | 7% |
| ExpressLine Operating Credit | 5% | 6% | 7% |
| Seasonal Operating Loan | 5% | 6% | 7% |
| Revolving Operating Line | 5% | 6% | 7% |
| Borrowing Base Operating Line | 4% | 6% | 7% |
| Agribusiness Revolving Line | 4% | 6% | 7% |

## Illustration (hypothetical charge base of USD 3,000.00)

| Late charges in the twenty-four whole months before today | Percentage on a Borrowing Base Operating Line | Charge base times the percentage |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 4% | USD 120.00 |
| 1 | 6% | USD 180.00 |
| 2 | 7% | USD 210.00 |
